title: The Karaga
setting: Saturday night. Dharmaraya Swamy temple, Thigalarpet. The street is packed shoulder-to-shoulder. Karthik has one hand on your forearm so you don't lose him. The procession is coming.

beats.native: ಬಾಸ್, ನೋಡು. ಆ ಮನುಷ್ಯ — Karaga ಹೊತ್ತಿರೋವ. ಒಂದು ಗಂಟೆ ಆಯ್ತು dance. ಹೂವಿನ ಭಾರ ಮಾತ್ರ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತು kilo.
beats.translit: bās, nōḍu. ā manuṣya — Karaga hottirōva. ondu gaṇṭe āytu dance. hūvina bhāra mātra ippattu kilo.
beats.en: Boss, look. That man — carrying the Karaga. Dancing for an hour now. The flowers alone weigh twenty kilos.
beats.beat: the drums get closer, the crowd presses forward

beats.native: Ee festival ನೂರಾರು ವರ್ಷ ಇಂದ. ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಒರಿಜಿನಲ್. Tigala community ಇದು — ಹಿಂದೆ ಜನರು farming, ಗಾರ್ಡನಿಂಗ್.
beats.translit: ee festival nūrāru varṣa inda. Beṅgaḷūrina original. Tigala community idu — hinde janaru farming, gardening.
beats.en: This festival's been going for centuries. Original to Bangalore. Tigala community — historically farmers, gardeners.
beats.beat: he tells you this every Karaga, but you wouldn't know that

beats.prompt: The procession passes. Drums, jasmine, sweat. You say:

choices.native: Ee weight ಜೊತೆ ಒಂದು ಗಂಟೆ dance. ಇದನ್ನ practice ಎಷ್ಟು ತಿಂಗಳು ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ?
choices.translit: ee weight joḍe ondu gaṇṭe dance. idanna practice eṣṭu tiṅgaḷu māḍtāre?
choices.en: An hour of dancing with that weight. How many months do they practise?
I had no idea this was a whole thing. Wild.

beats.native: Years ಬಾಸ್. ಒಂದು ಕುಟುಂಬದಿಂದ ಒಬ್ಬ. ಸಣ್ಣ ವಯಸ್ಸಿಂದ ತರಬೇತಿ. ನಮ್ಮ ತಾತ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಹೇಳಿದ್ರು — Karaga ಹೊರೋವ ಆಗೋಕೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಆದ್ರೆ, ಊರಿಗೆ ಊರು celebrate ಮಾಡ್ತೆ.
beats.translit: years bās. ondu kuṭumbadinda obba. saṇṇa vayassinda tarabēti. namma tāta omme hēḷidru — Karaga horōva āgōke obba āyke ādre, ūrige ūru celebrate māḍte.
beats.en: Years, boss. One per family. Training from a young age. My grandfather once told me — when someone's chosen to carry the Karaga, the whole town celebrates.
beats.beat: the noise around you somehow drops for just this one line

beats.native: Bangalore ಅಂದ್ರೆ tech ಮಾತ್ರ ಅಲ್ಲ ಬಾಸ್. ಇದು — this is also Bangalore.
beats.translit: Bangalore andre tech mātra alla bās. idu — this is also Bangalore.
beats.en: Bangalore isn't just tech, boss. This — this is also Bangalore.
beats.beat: doesn't look at you. watches the procession turn the corner.

choices.native: ಧನ್ಯವಾದ Karthik. ಇದು ತೋರಿಸಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ. Ee ride internet ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಗಲ್ಲ.
choices.translit: dhanyavāda Karthik. idu tōrisiddakke. ee ride internet-nalli sigalla.
choices.en: Thanks, Karthik. For showing me this. You don't get this from the internet.
Thanks for bringing me, man. Really.

beats.native: Welcome. ಈಗ ಒಂದು dosa — ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಅಂಗಡಿ ಇದೆ, ಪ್ರತಿ Karaga night open. ಬಾ.
beats.translit: welcome. īga ondu dosa — alli ondu aṅgaḍi ide, prati Karaga night open. bā.
beats.en: Welcome. Now a dosa — there's a place, open every Karaga night. Come.
